component.name: Yacr
component.summary: View, measure and annotate DWG/DXF drawings
查看、测量与批注 DWG/DXF 图纸

description.p: Yacr is a CAD drawing viewer, measurement and annotation application written in Rust, running as a Linux desktop host. It opens local DWG/DXF drawings, shows model space and supported layouts, and measures distance, polyline length, angle and polygon area.
Yacr 是一个用 Rust 编写的 CAD 图纸查看、测量与批注应用，以 Linux 桌面宿主形式运行。 它可打开本地 DWG/DXF 图纸，查看模型空间与受支持的布局，并测量距离、折线长度、 角度与多边形面积。
